newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil IGP-DI inflation rises 0.22 pct in October.
newsitem.headline: Brazil IGP-DI inflation rises 0.22 pct in October.

text.p: Brazil's Indice Geral de Precos - Disponibilidade Interna (IGP-DI) rose 0.22 percent in October, against a 0.13 percent advance in September, the independent research institute Getulio Vargas (FGV) said.

The IGP-DI index is a compilation of three inflation indices -- the wholesale price index, which rose 0.24 percent, the consumer price index, which increased 0.18 percent, and the national index of constructions costs, which gained 0.26 percent in the period.
The FGV releases the IGP-DI figure once a month.
